items.tx:
The Leader of the Opposition, @RahulGandhi, has raised the issue of the dodgy sale of IDBI Bank. For anyone who needs a refresher on the IDBI Bank sale - which smacks of crony capitalism-read on.

▪️IDBI Bank was sold to Canada-based Fairfax Financial Holdings for Rs 52,878 crore at Rs 81 per share

▪️The sale happened after rules were changed mid-process and at a much lower price than the original reserve price of ₹94.42, which was discarded

▪️Initial sealed bids from Fairfax and another entity were below the minimum reserve price of Rs 94.42. Fairfax bids came at Rs 75

▪️Core Group of Secretaries on Disinvestment changed valuation method, asked Fairfax and another bidder to give new bids

▪️Fairfax revised bid to Rs 81 per share, still well below the original reserve price of Rs 94.42

▪️Modi govt accepted it and also gave some relief on disputed tax claims on IDBI Bank

▪️In January 2019, LIC infused Rs 21,624 crore in IDBI when the bank was placed under the RBI’s strict Prompt Corrective Action framework

▪️LIC’s investment was at an average of ~₹61 per share to acquire a 51% controlling stake

▪️Later that year, LIC pumped in another ₹4,743 crore

▪️LIC’s investment required a special exemption from IRDAI, because normal rules cap an insurer’s stake in a listed company at 15%

▪️Over ₹26,000 crore of policyholders’ savings was used and locked up for years to clean the balance sheet and rescue IDBI Bank, only so that it could be stealthily sold
 
▪️The govt and LIC have been reduced to minority holders with no board seats

▪️Modi Govt’s internal note says this sale was necessary because the govt is under fiscal stress due to high energy prices, lack of FDI inflows and the falling Rupee

▪️The justification for the change of rules and methodology was made by citing General Financial Rules for the sale of government physical assets (not shares)

▪️It cited the Railway Stores Code on auctioning scrap: "Bids lower than the reserve prices may, however, be accepted by the Depot Officer where found expedient provided the Depot Officer doing so records his reasons in writing."

▪️IDBI Bank’s Gross NPA was at 31.78% in September 2018. The bank posted losses for 13 consecutive quarters accumulating to about ₹41,800 crore

▪️IDBI Bank entered RBI’s PCA in May 2017 and exited PCA on 10 March 2021 after the December 2020 results showed a turnaround 

▪️IDBI Bank’s 
 FY25 profit: ₹7,515 crore
 FY26 profit: ₹9,513 crore• 
Total business crossed ₹6.27 lakh crore by September 2026 

▪️▪️But the questions that remain unanswered:

🔺Why did the govt change the bidding rules after shortlisting and opening sealed bids, without starting the process from scratch?

🔺New bidders might have wanted to participate under the changed rules, why were they denied a chance?

🔺Why was the second bidder’s identity kept hidden on national-security grounds? 

🔺Why should policyholders’ savings be used to clean up assets which are then monetised and made to appear like a distress exit than a transparent market sale?

🔺Finally, why must a bank which has turned profitable be sold at much lower valuation - actually sold at all?

▪️▪️The IDBI sale proves yet again that public and policyholder money absorbs the losses, revives the asset which is then cleaned up and sold without transparency to a bidder of govt’s choice - keeping norms at bay and changing rules midway. It also raises the important question of why must an asset which has turned profitable be sold, especially at lower valuation?

Source: BusinessWorld’s investigative report by Palak Shah

Something is going horribly wrong in the Senate race in Michigan. And I am going to keep calling it out.

On the one hand, the Republicans are conducting a campaign of blatant anti-Muslim fear mongering. Mike Rogers, Donald Trump and the rest of the GOP need to knock it off. Mike needs to personally and repeatedly denounce hate against Muslims.

But now, at the same time, we have TWO ads from the Democratic side that ALSO traffic in hate and intolerance — causing alarm for some Black and Jewish voters.

Seriously— WTF ????

The first ad was from Rebellion PAC (NOT the official Abdul El-Sayyed campaign). It suggested that Americans can’t buy groceries because the USA sends so much money to Israel.

That is a lie. The USA spends less than 00.1 percent of our federal budget on support for Israel. But this ad pretends bananas cost too much because the Jewish state is bleeding us dry. TOTALLY nuts. And yet — this kind of thinking has always put Jewish lives at risk. Blaming Jews for everyone’s economic problems has a long, bloody history.

Abdul did try to separate himself from the ad. He accurately noted that his campaign didn’t produce it. But the problem is: if you listen, Abdul actually NEVER DENOUNCED the CONTENT of the ad. He never said, “This ad is wrong.”

He just said, “Hey, it wasn’t me.” 😬😬😬

That ad — and Abdul’s refusal to forthrightly denounce it — is scaring some Jewish Democrats in Michigan, who now are more reluctant to vote for him.

In other words, that one ad alone is jeopardizing our party’s shot at taking back the U.S. Senate.

BUT IT GETS WORSE!

Then Abdul’s formal, official campaign put out its OWN ad — which features none other than the vile and contemptible Tucker Carlson (!!!). As you know, Tucker Carlson is a rabid, anti-Black bigot who also traffics in anti-Jewish stereotypes. He is anathema to most Black people and most Jews.

No Democrat should ever celebrate the words of a white nationalist who actively undermines the safety of Black people and Jewish people.

Moreover, given the importance of Black and Jewish Democrats to our victory in Michigan, the decision to include Tucker Carlson in any Democratic ad there is truly baffling.

Why am I speaking out about this now? Because I want Democrats to build a winning coalition — now and into the future. Chasing off any Black or Jewish voters is a path to defeat — both in the short term and the long term.

As proud Democrats, it can feel uncomfortable or risky to speak against intolerance in our own party, especially just days before a national election. It would be easier for us to let this stuff slide, shut up and close ranks.

But that would make us hypocrites. For 10 years, we Democrats have watched with dismay and disgust as Republicans (who know better) have refused to challenge ANY bad ideas or bad actions in their own ranks. As a result, their party curdled into a cult — one that is now wrecking the country AND falling apart.

As Democrats, we should not make the same mistake.

Anti-Jewish hate is wrong. Period.

Tucker Carlson’s white nationalism is wrong. Period.

All candidates in Michigan need to say that clearly— and then pull down/denounce any ads that normalize hate or elevate hate mongers.

I'm French. I run an AI company. I live between Paris and San Francisco, so I see both sides of the Atlantic. And I can see what's coming.

We are living through the most consequential civilizational shift in human history. AI is not another tech cycle. Within ten years it will rewrite how we work, how we learn, how we create wealth, and how we decide what is true.

AI can become the greatest instrument of freedom ever built, or the most perfect instrument of control. Same technology. The only difference is who writes the rules.

That is the choice in front of you.

On one side, the world the globalists have been dreaming of for decades. A managed society run by unelected institutions, from Brussels to Davos. Experts deciding what you may say, what you may buy, what counts as true. And now, with AI, the tools to enforce it at scale.

On the other side, a new world, far fairer. Built on reality instead of narratives. Where you can build, speak and trade without asking permission. Where we finally stop building entire systems on lies everyone can see.

If the Democrats take back power, there's a strong chance the first world wins.

How can I be so sure? Because I live in the trailer.

In Europe, the machinery is already built.

The Digital Services Act lets Brussels fine a platform up to 6% of its global revenue for failing to manage "systemic risks" as vague as "negative effects on civic discourse." The first fine ever issued under it went to X. €120 million.

The digital euro: in July, the European Parliament voted 416 to 169 to move it forward. Love him or hate him, you know he's authentic. He bought Twitter and gave you your voice back. He has been smeared, boycotted and targeted by every institution that used to own the narrative, and he never bent. He never made a deal with the devil.

That is not a policy agenda. That is an exit from democracy. And once the door is locked from the inside, the European machine crosses the Atlantic. The speech police. The supervised money. The managed truth. All of it running on AI.

Europe was the trailer. Don't let America become the movie.

The entire West is watching you. If America falls, there is nowhere left to go. You are the last country on Earth where an ordinary citizen can still say no, and make it count.

On November 3rd, vote like the free world depends on it.

items.tx:
Modi Government sold IDBI Bank at a throwaway price!

Another lie of Rahul Gandhi that is devoid of any fact. Not a single statement in his tweet is true.

He has conveniently ignored the history of IDBI Bank and the the mess the UPA government made of IDBI Bank. 

Reckless lending between 2004 and 2014 pushed IDBI into a mountain of bad loans. UPA ignored this and did not even recognise these bad loans. Banks including IDBI had stopped lending and were at verge of going bankrupt!

By September 2018, its gross NPA ratio had reached a staggering 31.8%. Nearly 1 in every 3 rupees of loans had turned bad!

The Modi Government had to clean up this mess, protect depositors and rescue the bank from its financial crisis.

Now look at what happened under Modi:

Gross NPAs: 31.8% in 2018 → just 2.3% in March 2026.

Annual profit: ₹9,513 crore in FY 2025-26.

A bank crippled by bad loans was transformed into a profitable institution attracting global investors.

And what did the Government and LIC secure from the sale? A massive ₹52,878 crore!

Fairfax's winning bid of ₹81 per share was higher than the benchmark valuation of ₹75.99. So much for the manufactured outrage about a throwaway price.

And here's another fact conveniently buried: IDBI was already classified as a private-sector bank in 2019 following LIC's takeover. The Government wasn't selling 100% of the bank in the first place!

The deal has been described as India's largest-ever FDI transaction in the financial sector. Fairfax has even linked its investment to India's Viksit Bharat 2047 vision.

The contrast couldn't be clearer.

The UPA-era lending legacy left IDBI drowning in bad loans. The Modi Government cleaned up the balance sheet, restored profitability, protected depositors and secured a ₹52,878 crore transaction.

Congress had destroyed IDBI. Modi government is standing with employees of IDBI and depositors of IDBI and have enabled turnaround of the bank!

From 31.8% bad loans to 2.3%. From a banking crisis to ₹9,513 crore in annual profits. From a rescue operation to India's largest financial-sector FDI deal.

items.tx:
He wrote "You're My Best Friend" for her the year they married. She raised six children while he toured the world with Queen. Fifty years later — they're still in the same house in Putney. Veronica Tetzlaff is the most private person in rock history.

On March 26th, 1971 — John Deacon walked into a college disco in London.

He had joined Queen just two months earlier. Across the room was a young woman named Veronica Tetzlaff — born in Sheffield, of Polish ancestry, studying at the Maria Assumpta Teacher Training College.

They met. They started dating.

Veronica was pursuing a teacher training course in Kensington. After a few years of dating — they married on January 18th, 1975. Veronica was already pregnant at the time of the wedding.

Queen was rising. World tours were starting. Bohemian Rhapsody was coming.

A friend who knew Veronica well said — "She didn't wear any makeup and wore fairly plain clothes. She is a lovely person, completely unpretentious. I've got the impression down the years that their children are the most important things to her."

Together they had six children — Robert in 1975, Michael in 1978, Laura in 1979, Joshua in 1983, Luke in 1992, and Cameron in 1993.

While John played bass on some of the greatest records in history — Veronica raised their family quietly. No interviews. No premieres. No fame.

She chose to live a quiet life away from public attention to raise their children — a distinction she has maintained for over fifty years.

Today — John and Veronica still live together in Putney, South West London.

John wrote "You're My Best Friend" for her in 1975 — the same year they married.

Fifty years later — the song still plays on radio stations worldwide.

And the woman it was written for has never once spoken about it publicly.

Some love stories don't need an audience.

#johndeacon #queen

items.t: 🚨 OLESHKY: A HUMANITARIAN MISSION OR A LARGE-SCALE RUSSIAN INFORMATION OPERATION What is happening around Oleshky increasingly reminds me of the information wa

qt.t:
🚨 Oleshky. Russian Propaganda and a Scenario We Have Already Seen in Donbas in 2014.

First of all, I want to draw attention to the fact that what we are seeing is not simply footage of a so-called humanitarian operation, but material produced by the Russian state news agency TASS.

In my assessment, it bears the characteristics of a propaganda product that could serve several purposes simultaneously.

The first is the domestic mobilization of Russian society.

We witnessed similar information warfare mechanisms in Donbas in 2014: the rhetoric of “liberation,” the demonization of Ukraine, accusations against the West and NATO, and the portrayal of Russia as a protector of the population.

Such narratives can sustain public support for aggression and create justifications for continuing the war.

The second is the creation of material that could be used to justify Russia’s actions in the future.

If evidence of the forced displacement of Ukrainian civilians emerges later, this footage could be used to promote the narrative that people were supposedly evacuated voluntarily and rescued.

This is precisely the risk we warned about even before the operation began.

TASS photographs date

items.tx:
🚨 OLESHKY: A HUMANITARIAN MISSION OR A LARGE-SCALE RUSSIAN INFORMATION OPERATION

What is happening around Oleshky increasingly reminds me of the information warfare mechanisms Russia used in Donbas in 2014.

And I want to draw attention not only to the humanitarian operation mediated by Melania Trump, but also to who is covering it, what narratives are being spread, and who benefits from them.

Russian state media are showing buses, ambulances, humanitarian supplies, Russian soldiers, and supposedly “rescued” civilians.

At the same time, reports are emerging in which the Ukrainian Armed Forces are accused of shelling residential buildings, laying mines, and obstructing evacuations.

A very clear narrative is being constructed:

Russia is the savior. Ukraine is the aggressor. The Russian army is the protector of civilians.

We saw something similar in 2014, when the Kremlin used the rhetoric of the “liberation of Donbas” to justify its intervention and build domestic support within Russia.

Today, these narratives could also be used to maintain public support for the war, justify Russian aggression, and encourage further military mobilization.

And now comes the most interesting part: foreign journalists.

The Russian side reports that dozens of media representatives are present, including American and other foreign journalists.

Among those whose statements are being broadcast by the Russian military television channel Zvezda is an American journalist, Rick Sanchez.

But Rick Sanchez is a presenter on RT, the Russian state-funded propaganda outlet.

His program, Sanchez Effect, is broadcast by RT itself.

Therefore, presenting Sanchez merely as an independent American journalist while concealing his professional ties to Russian state media is misleading the audience.

Having American citizenship does not make a journalist independent of the editorial policies of the media organization they work for.

And when such a journalist appears on a Russian military television channel, repeats accusations against Ukraine, and portrays Russia as a country supposedly open to peace, a legitimate question arises:

Is this independent documentation of a humanitarian operation, or the promotion of a Russian state narrative?

I am also deeply concerned about the imbalance in media coverage.

We see numerous Russian reports about humanitarian supplies, buses, and statements from Russian officials.

But where are the equally accessible, independently documented testimonies of the residents of Oleshky themselves?

Where is the full Ukrainian perspective, including accounts of life under occupation and documentation of possible violations of international humanitarian law?

Where are the guarantees that civilians can speak freely without Russian soldiers present, choose their evacuation destination voluntarily, and remain protected from forced displacement?

I am not claiming that every person appearing in these reports is lying. And humanitarian assistance must be provided to people regardless of who delivers it.

But a humanitarian mission must not become an information warfare instrument for the very state that occupies this territory.

Especially when its media coverage uses mechanisms familiar from 2014: demonizing Ukraine, portraying Russia as a savior, and using foreign voices to lend international legitimacy to that portrayal.

Melania Trump and everyone involved in this humanitarian mission must understand the risk of its outcomes being exploited by Russian propaganda.

We must examine not only how many buses arrived in Oleshky, but also where people are being taken, who controls their movements, whether independent monitoring exists, and what happens after the television cameras stop filming.

Because for Ukraine, this is not merely a question of information warfare.

It is a question of the lives, freedom, and fundamental rights of our citizens.

Humanitarian aid must save lives. It must not legitimize Russian occupation.

#Oleshky

items.tx:
🚨 OLESHKY. I WARNED ABOUT THIS MORE THAN A MONTH AGO. NOW I DEMAND ANSWERS FROM THE WHITE HOUSE AND THE U.S. CONGRESS ‼️

A little over a month ago, when the world was saying “Google Oleshky” and talking about the humanitarian catastrophe, I immediately recognized the danger: Russia would try to turn the tragedy of Oleshky into a repetition of the Donbas scenario of 2014.

On September 24, I had already publicly warned about this. I recorded two videos explaining the mechanisms I could already see with my own eyes: the exploitation of civilian suffering, humanitarian rhetoric, and information manipulation to justify Russian aggression.

And what are we seeing today?

The White House announced a humanitarian agreement mediated by Melania Trump. Meanwhile, Russian state media are turning coverage of this operation into a demonstration of the Russian army’s supposed humanity.

Putin, a humanitarian? Russia, a savior?

This is precisely the image the Kremlin now has an opportunity to promote to Russian society and international audiences.

And all of this is happening just before the U.S. midterm elections.

I believe the White House must explain why its humanitarian initiative is creating such advantageous propaganda opportunities for the Kremlin.

And I demand an investigation into whether these agreements are being exploited for Donald Trump’s political interests ahead of the elections.

What exactly did American representatives discuss with the Russian leadership? What roles did Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner play? What agreements were reached?

Were there political arrangements that were never disclosed to Ukrainian society?

These questions require an independent investigation, not another press conference.

It is unacceptable to me that the humanitarian catastrophe of Ukrainians could become political currency in relations between Washington and Moscow.

These are human lives. These are Ukrainians who have been living under Russian occupation for years.

And if their suffering is being exploited for political deals or election campaigning, that is a moral catastrophe.

I am addressing both Democrats and Republicans in the U.S. House of Representatives and Senate: DEMAND FULL TRANSPARENCY IMMEDIATELY!

Congress must investigate every aspect of how this agreement was negotiated, the security guarantees for civilians, the involvement of Russian state media, and the possible political exploitation of this operation.

How could American authorities allow a humanitarian initiative to become a propaganda platform for the very state occupying Oleshky?

DO NOT ALLOW UKRAINIAN BLOOD TO BE USED FOR POLITICAL GAMES.

This is now a question of accountability not only for Russia, but also for American officials and the decisions they make.

We must act now, while there is still time to protect civilians, ensure independent international monitoring, and prevent Russia from rewriting the history of this tragedy.

I warned about the risk of repeating the Donbas scenario of 2014 back on September 24. Today, we can see why those warnings should never have been ignored.
